title: Magnet Mayhem
subtitle: A guided tour of Magnet Canyon goes full polarity when Reno refuses to slow down.

pages.alt: Page 1: The guide welcomes the crew to Magnet Canyon and presents magnetic blocks. Reno rolls in shouting no brakes, the green dino calls the 42-piece structure unstable while the teal dino fears the north pole will reject its personality, and Reno ends up officially attached to a block cube.

Page 2: One second later, Reno shows off a turbo trunk built out of magnetic blocks while the teal dino asks what happens if they attract a meteor. The guide reports that magnets attract metal and Reno attracts bad decisions, the green dino rates the arch zero safety margin, and the entire crew ends up stuck together.

Page 3: Meanwhile in the magnet train, Reno leads a dino-train with zero brakes. The teal dino never signed a waiver, the green dino calls the commute 99.8 percent embarrassing, and the guide declares a magnetic jam, which is at least togetherness.

Page 4: At the Polarity Chasm the green dino unveils a magnetic bridge and the teal dino worries gravity holds a grudge. The guide shows dramatic flair, the bridge flings the whole crew airborne, and the blueprint is declared wrong.

Page 5: Inside Magnet-O-Fortress the guide welcomes the crew, then gets covered in magnet balls and protests that its face screws are not a hat rack. The teal dino is trapped inside a block cube and Reno races for the shiny card.

Page 6: Maximum polarity. The green dino calls for a 45-degree polarity reversal while the guide reboots with ctrl plus alt plus de-magnetize. Reno skips the math and rolls faster, and the teal dino bursts free in a pop of flying magnets.
